name: Alt: daybed first, an L of the four-screen run and a work return under the window
notes:
Alternative (F-41): the daybed gets priority. A twin VIHALS daybed takes the left wall, so the work desk turns along the window wall as the L's return and one chair in the inside corner swivels between the two desks. Gives up: a standing work desk (2026-10-23: with 36" kept clear in front of the wardrobe, F-31, the daybed must end at y 116, and the 27 1/2"-deep TRAVSPORT above its head left it 5/8" short, so the return is the 19 5/8"-deep MICKE; the four-screen run still sits and stands), a glare-free work screen (the return's monitor faces the window, so the blinds come half down), a chair per station (one serves the L), and floor BESTÅ (a door there would hit the daybed or the return).
desk-1 and desk-2 MITTZON 55 1/8 + 47 1/4: the personal run on the right wall, rot 90, x 74.5-106, y 12-114.4 (102 3/8"); F-33 6" from the heater face (heater-depth-assumed); F-31 7.6" above the door's swing (assumed-position:door); F-35 34" from their front to the daybed: 30" for the chair is met, and the 42" for someone passing behind applies only to a guest walking to the daybed's head (tight:34 then) · four 32" screens as in a.
desk-3 MICKE 55 7/8x19 5/8" white, fixed height: the return along the window wall, rot 0, x 18.6-74.5, y 12-31.6, its back 6" from the heater face (F-33) · under-window, sill-unmeasured (F-38: 29 1/2" high), assumed-position:window; F-35 30" behind it at the corner chair; 7.25" above the daybed's head. The laptop and the work monitor sit at its right end by the corner, with 9 3/8" to spare at its left end (55.875 − 28 − 18.5; final audit 2026-10-26).
chair-1 FLINTAN: the L's inside corner, x 46-74, y 41-69, facing the run or turned to the return · fits.
daybed-1 VIHALS twin daybed frame (no trundle): left wall, rot 270, x 0-40.5, y 38.9-116; F-33 bedding 32.9" from the heater face; F-31 its foot on the edge of the wardrobe's 36" landing (assumed-position:closet); F-34 34" along its open side to the desks · fits. 77 1/8 x 40 1/2" closed and open: a little smaller than HEMNES and with nothing to pull out, but more than twice the chair bed of a and d.
plant-1 FEJKA monstera: the top-left corner by the window, x 4-11.5, y 25-32.5, under the wall-hung BESTÅ · fits. lamp-1 TÅGARP: bottom-left corner past the daybed's foot, x 0.5-9.5, y 119-128, left of the wardrobe's landing (assumed-position:closet), its arm over the daybed · fits.
rug-1 LOHALS (rug layer): x 22.5-74.5, y 39-116, 18" under the daybed and out to the desks. rug-2 KOLON (rug layer): x 35.1-74.5, y 41-88.25 under chair-1, its left 5" under the daybed's rail (10 1/4" free under it).
storage-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with door (top, F-63): hung on the left wall in the top-left corner, x 0-16.5, y 12.5-36.1, its underside about 50" up on one BESTÅ suspension rail; its door swings above the return's spare end. art-1 PJÄTTERYD 3-pack (top): the three 22" canvases in a row over the daybed, y 43.4-111.4. lamp-2 RÖDFLIK (top): the return's left end, the daybed's reading lamp (under-window). lamp-3 RÖDFLIK (top): desk-2's door end.
Extras: the blinds, two HUANUO arms, two cable trays, the FREIVID mat (for standing at the personal run), the ELLOVEN, the suspension rail; the daybed's ÅSVANG twin mattress, DVALA fitted sheet, duvet cover, insert and pillow; three back cushions (two gray-green, one off-white) with inserts; the throw.
Not placed: the chair bed (a, d); the second FLINTAN; the floor BESTÅ; the TRAVSPORT ikea-49620956 (5/8" too deep for the return, above); the 2026-10-22 ALEX, BILLY and HEMNES (see a).
Total $2,625.73 (final audit 2026-10-26). Prices: the new pieces as of 2026-10-23; the reused ones (FLINTAN, TÅGARP, RÖDFLIK, FEJKA, LOHALS, PJÄTTERYD, HOPPVALS, FÖRSÄSONG, ELLOVEN, bedding and textiles) as of 2026-10-22, price-stale (F-02).
Final audit 2026-10-26, for every office layout: the HUANUO arms are C-clamps on the desks' back edges, and every run desk stands flush against its wall, so either the desk stands off the wall by the clamp's depth (not on the listing: measure the arm; at 2" the way in past the L's return becomes 31.8" in e and g, still over 30") or the arms use their grommet mount (the UPLIFT is configured with two grommets). No outlets are mapped: three motors, five screens, a PC and the lamps need a power strip in each cable tray (the MITTZON page offers KOPPLA, not captured) with a slack loop for the desk's 25" of travel, on the left wall or the right wall above the door. The wardrobe's left door, open 90°, stands on its hinge line at x 10, 1/2" from the TÅGARP and 1 1/2" from the plant's pot: fit a 90° stop on that door, and measure the room door's width and the wardrobe's distance from the right corner (the door as drawn, opened flat, lands 2" over the wardrobe's end). The way from the door to the job desk and the window passes the parked chair at the run (or the L) with 13 to 18 1/2" to spare, so the 30" walkway holds with the chairs pushed in.
